items.title: Where Does Nvidia Go From Here?
items.take: Sunday's episode frames the week's central question: what Nvidia looks like under interim CEO Colette Kress, and whether the AI trade holds together without its founder. Everything else this week orbits that answer.

items.title: Nvidia's first post-Jensen earnings and Anthropic's IPO: What to watch this week
items.take: Nvidia reports its first post-Huang quarter Tuesday after the close, with Kress helming the 5 p.m. call. Anthropic's IPO prices Wednesday and starts trading Thursday on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT, a test that could set the standard for rival OpenAI's own debut next year.

items.title: 1 Stock to Buy, 1 Stock to Sell This Week: Nvidia, Home Depot
items.take: Odds of a 25-basis-point December hike are approaching 90%, with about 10% priced for a half-point move. Wall Street expects Nvidia revenue near $108.9 billion, up about 91% year over year, and much of the leadership pain is already priced in after the rapid decline.

items.title: Nvidia Earnings and Anthropic IPO Land in Same Week, Testing Both Ends of the AI Supply Chain
items.take: Anthropic is raising up to roughly $100 billion, with IPO orders already about six times the shares on offer. October retail sales land Tuesday and the Fed's October meeting minutes come Thursday, both shaping the December decision.

items.title: 3 Key Events in the Coming Week That Could Move AI Stocks and Crypto
items.take: A beat from Nvidia plus a steady outlook from Kress would ease the leadership fears, and a strong Anthropic debut would add to it, but a hawkish tone in the Fed minutes could still cap any rebound. The next Fed decision is December 9.
